verdict.rationale: Cloudflare publishes an official Sandbox SDK (JS/TS) with a rich, well-documented API surface—exec, file I/O, code interpreter, sessions, ports/tunnels, git, Docker, bindings—clearly aimed at AI-agent builders (docs-1–40, docs-24 explicitly calling out AI agent use cases). Community discussion (comm-1, comm-9) confirms real developers are building against it and comparing it to alternatives like e2b, corroborating hands-on adoption beyond just docs. Missing for 10: independent third-party benchmarking/tutorials building full agent products on the SDK, and explicit multi-language (e.g., Python-native) SDK parity beyond the in-sandbox code interpreter.
